_about: Lewis Carroll's (Charles Lutwidge Dodgson, 1832-1898) books: the two Alices and their manuscript and nursery forms, Sylvie and Bruno, the verse (Snark, Phantasmagoria, Rhyme? and Reason?, Three Sunsets), A Tangled Tale, and the logic and mathematics he published as Carroll or Dodgson. Clean Gutenberg text; all published before 1930: US public domain. Further Nonsense (1926) is Langford Reed's gathering of Carroll's own pieces, published 1926, so also before 1930; Reed's editorial matter rides with it.
